result:
No lint errors. Everything type-checks, lints cleanly, and the full test suite (617 tests) passes. The implementation is complete:

- **`member-service.ts`**: added `suspendMember`, `reinstateMember`, `MemberSuspendedError`, self/outranking guards, and updated `assertLastOwnerRetained` to only count active owners as "remaining".
- **`member-repository.ts`**: added `setMemberStatus`, stopped `archiveMember` from overloading `status`, and made `countActiveMembers` count all live members (suspended keep their seat).
- **`organization-repository.ts`**: org switcher (`listOrgsForUser`) now excludes suspended members.
- **`usage-repository.ts`**: seat rollup counts suspended members too.
- **`notification-service.ts`** / **`digest-service.ts`**: suspended members get no notifications and are skipped by the digest.
- **`comment-service.ts`**: `@mentions` no longer resolve to suspended members, client-supplied ids for them are dropped.
- **`issue-service.ts`**: creating or assigning an issue to a suspended member throws `MemberSuspendedError` before any write.
- **`types/event.ts`, `types/activity.ts`, `schemas/activity.ts`, `activity-labels.ts`, `activity-service.ts`**: added `member.suspended`/`member.reinstated` as domain events and audit actions.
- **`schemas/member.ts`**: added `suspendMemberSchema`/`reinstateMemberSchema`.

Actor resolution (`resolveActor`, `resolveActorForOrg`, `switchActiveOrg`) already gated on `status !== "active"`, so suspended members are automatically locked out there without further changes.
